notes.title: The game is out! Here's how it was made.
notes.content:
Dear Players,

My second free game is now officially out on Steam! I hope that you'll have a great time crushing images in it. 😉

If you'd like to take a peek "behind the scenes" and see how this game was made, here's a short video where I talk about the process of its development 👾:

[previewyoutube=acgaTB_iD38;full][/previewyoutube]

If you are interested in more games from me (including another free one), you can find them [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/Khud0]here[/url] 🎮. 

Finally, if you like what I'm doing, please consider supporting my work! You can do so by telling your friends to download my games, making a video/post about them or purchasing a "donation DLC" like this one 🤟:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2696990/Mossy_Pixels_Lucky_Find/

Thanks for reading. Have a fantastic winter season! 🎅

Sincerely yours,
Ivan (Khud0)

notes.title: Mossy Pixels's Kickstarter campaign is now live!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

My 12th Steam release, Mossy Pixels, is going to be my second relaxing [u]free[/u] game! If you'd like to take a part in this project and get your name inscribed in it, please consider supporting it over on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/khud0/mossy-pixel]Kickstarter[/url]. <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44403952/b2cce5a001b2b660dc0eee6b58e17366108162b1.gif[/img]

And don't forget to wishlist Mossy Pixels on Steam, so that you can enjoy destroying mossy surfaces pixel-by-pixel as soon as it gets released!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2618370/Mossy_Pixels/

This game [u]will[/u] be released and [u]will[/u] be [u]100% free for everyone[/u], regardless of whether it reaches its funding goal or not. However, your support would greatly help me stay on track and keep making 1 free game per year in the future!

Speaking of which, don't forget to grab my previous free game, in case you missed it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2067760/Trash_Bomber/

Thank you for playing my games and for considering helping me out. Have a wonderful day! :)

Kind regards,
Ivan (Khud0)
